proposals.evidence: Turner laghu documents the metathesized light adjectives Lahnda hôla/haulā, Punjabi haulā, Hindi harū/haruā and Gujarati haḷvũ. These are qualified comparisons with that regional family, including h-loss and r/ṛ/l variants. The evidence does not establish a separate prehistoric stem for each modern phonetic variant.
